source: authored from the in-game shop; not scraped
note: Shop equipment reference. Unlike heroes.json, this file has no canonical machine-readable source behind it — the rows are authored, so exact prices and stat values can drift a patch behind the game and the effect text is deliberately descriptive rather than numeric. What it is for is the buy decision: which item answers which threat. Roam and jungle enchantments are not covered yet.
caption: Authored reference, not scraped: the buy decision is the point, and exact prices and values can sit a patch behind the game.

categories.label: Attack
categories.blurb: Physical damage, attack speed, crit and physical penetration.

categories.label: Magic
categories.blurb: Magic power, magic penetration, cooldown and spell vamp.

categories.label: Defense
categories.blurb: HP, physical and magic defence, and the passives that answer a specific threat.

categories.label: Movement
categories.blurb: Boots. One slot, chosen for the matchup rather than the hero.

items.name: Blade of Despair

passive.name: Despair
passive.text: +25% Physical ATK against enemies below 50% HP.

items.buyWhen: The finisher slot on a carry that is already ahead.

items.name: Berserker's Fury

passive.name: Doom
passive.text: Critical hits deal extra damage, and each critical hit briefly raises Physical ATK.

items.buyWhen: Every crit marksman; the first crit item in most gold-lane builds.

items.name: Endless Battle

passive.name: Divine Justice
passive.text: After using a skill, the next basic attack deals extra true damage and grants Movement Speed.

items.buyWhen: Fighters and junglers whose rotation is skill, then basic attack.

items.name: Hunter Strike

passive.name: Retribution
passive.text: Hitting enemy heroes repeatedly grants a burst of Movement Speed.

items.buyWhen: Assassins and junglers who need to close the gap and cut through armour.

items.name: Malefic Roar

passive.name: Armor Buster
passive.text: Ignores a large percentage of the target's Physical Defense.

items.buyWhen: The enemy has two or more heroes stacking Physical Defense.

items.name: Blade of the Heptaseas

passive.name: Ambush
passive.text: After a few seconds out of combat, the next basic attack deals heavy bonus Physical damage.

items.buyWhen: Ambush assassins who open a fight from stealth or from the bush.

items.name: Haas's Claws

passive.name: Insanity
passive.text: Lifesteal increases further while below 40% HP.

items.buyWhen: Basic-attack fighters who have to win extended duels.

items.name: Bloodlust Axe
items.buyWhen: Physical heroes whose damage comes from skills rather than basic attacks.

items.name: Demon Hunter Sword

passive.name: Devour
passive.text: Basic attacks deal bonus damage scaled off the target's current HP and heal the wielder.

items.buyWhen: The enemy front line is too healthy to burst — shred it per hit instead.

items.name: Golden Staff

passive.name: Rapid Strike
passive.text: Every third basic attack triggers extra hits; on-hit effects always apply.

items.buyWhen: Heroes with on-hit effects — the extra hits multiply them.

items.name: Corrosion Scythe

passive.name: Corrosion
passive.text: Basic attacks slow the target and stack Movement Speed on the wielder.

items.buyWhen: Chasing carries, and marksmen who need to kite rather than burst.

items.name: Sea Halberd

passive.name: Life Drain
passive.text: Damage dealt cuts the target's healing and HP regen roughly in half for a few seconds.

items.buyWhen: Against Estes, Rafaela, Uranus, Esmeralda, Yu Zhong or any lifesteal carry.

items.name: Windtalker

passive.name: Typhoon
passive.text: Periodically, the next basic attack strikes several nearby enemies for Magic damage and can crit.

items.buyWhen: An early tempo item for marksmen who need to clear waves and rotate.

items.name: Wind of Nature

active.name: Wind Chant
active.text: Become immune to Physical damage for a short time.

items.buyWhen: Against a physical assassin or marksman that deletes you first.

items.name: Rose Gold Meteor

passive.name: Lifeline
passive.text: Dropping below 30% HP grants a shield.

items.buyWhen: A carry item that answers one magic burst threat without a full defence slot.

items.name: Queen's Wings

passive.name: Demonize
passive.text: Below 40% HP, damage taken drops sharply and Spell Vamp rises.

items.buyWhen: Divers and offlaners who commit into the enemy team and have to come back out.

items.name: War Axe

passive.name: Fighting Spirit
passive.text: Dealing damage builds stacks of bonus Physical ATK and Movement Speed.

items.buyWhen: Fighters who stay in a fight long enough to build the stacks.

items.name: Holy Crystal

passive.name: Mystery
passive.text: Increases total Magic Power by a further percentage.

items.buyWhen: The single biggest damage slot in almost every mage build.

items.name: Lightning Truncheon

passive.name: Resonate
passive.text: Periodically, the next skill deals extra Magic damage to several targets.

items.buyWhen: Burst mages with a short combo — the proc lands on the opener.

items.name: Genius Wand

passive.name: Magic Bombard
passive.text: Magic damage strips Magic Defense from the target for a few seconds, stacking.

items.buyWhen: Mages with repeated hits rather than one burst.

items.name: Divine Glaive

passive.name: Spellbreaker
passive.text: Ignores a large percentage of the target's Magic Defense.

items.buyWhen: The enemy has bought Magic Defense — this is the answer, not more Magic Power.

items.name: Blood Wings

passive.name: Nirvana
passive.text: Converts Magic Power into a large shield that rebuilds out of combat.

items.buyWhen: A last-item mage slot when the enemy assassin is hunting you.

items.name: Concentrated Energy

passive.name: Recharge
passive.text: A kill or assist restores a share of max HP.

items.buyWhen: Mages who fight in the middle of the scrap instead of behind it.

items.name: Glowing Wand

passive.name: Scald
passive.text: Magic damage burns the target for a share of their max HP over a few seconds.

items.buyWhen: Against a high-HP front line that shrugs off flat burst.

items.name: Necklace of Durance

passive.name: Life Drain
passive.text: Damage dealt cuts the target's healing and HP regen roughly in half for a few seconds.

items.buyWhen: The mage's version of Sea Halberd — buy it against sustain, not after losing to it.

items.name: Ice Queen Wand

passive.name: Ice Bound
passive.text: Skill damage slows the target and speeds up the wielder.

items.buyWhen: Mages who need to hold an enemy still for a follow-up.

items.name: Feather of Heaven

passive.name: Flurry
passive.text: Basic attacks deal extra Magic damage.

items.buyWhen: Attack-speed magic hybrids such as Kagura's fans, Guinevere or Karrie-style builds.

items.name: Fleeting Time

passive.name: Timestream
passive.text: A kill or assist refunds a large share of the Ultimate's cooldown.

items.buyWhen: Mages whose ultimate is the whole kit — it chains kills together.

items.name: Winter Truncheon

active.name: Frozen
active.text: Freeze yourself briefly: immune to all damage and control.

items.buyWhen: Against burst that kills you before your combo finishes.

items.name: Enchanted Talisman

passive.name: Mana Spring
passive.text: Periodically restores a share of max Mana.

items.buyWhen: Early mage or support item when the mana bar is the real limit.

items.name: Clock of Destiny

passive.name: Time
passive.text: Stacks Magic Power and HP over time; at full stacks both are boosted again.

items.buyWhen: Buy it early or not at all — the value is in the stacks.

items.name: Immortality

passive.name: Immortal
passive.text: On death, revive after a short delay with some HP and a shield.

items.buyWhen: Anyone the enemy focuses first; the standard late-game insurance slot.

items.name: Athena's Shield

passive.name: Shield
passive.text: Periodically grants a shield that absorbs Magic damage.

items.buyWhen: Against a mage or magic assassin with one big burst rotation.

items.name: Antique Cuirass

passive.name: Deter
passive.text: Being hit by an enemy hero reduces their Physical ATK for a few seconds.

items.buyWhen: Against a physical jungler or fighter that is snowballing.

items.name: Blade Armor

passive.name: Bladed Armor
passive.text: Reflects a share of the Physical damage taken back at the attacker.

items.buyWhen: Against a fed physical carry — best on a tank that is being attacked anyway.

items.name: Dominance Ice

passive.name: Arctic Cold
passive.text: Slows nearby enemies' Attack Speed and Movement Speed, and weakens enemy shields and regen.

items.buyWhen: Against attack-speed carries, and against shield or regen stacking.

items.name: Radiant Armor

passive.name: Solidity
passive.text: Repeated Magic damage stacks further Magic damage reduction.

items.buyWhen: Against sustained magic damage — a mage that keeps hitting you, not one that bursts once.

items.name: Oracle

passive.name: Bless
passive.text: Boosts shields and HP regen received.

items.buyWhen: On heroes with their own shields or heals — it multiplies what they already have.

items.name: Cursed Helmet

passive.name: Burning Soul
passive.text: Continuously deals Magic damage to nearby enemies, scaled off your own max HP.

items.buyWhen: Tanks that split-push, and tanks that need to threaten a wave without items.

items.name: Guardian Helmet

passive.name: Recovery
passive.text: Restores a share of max HP every second while out of combat.

items.buyWhen: Offlaners who have to hold a lane alone and cannot keep going back.

items.name: Brute Force Breastplate

passive.name: Brute Force
passive.text: Using skills stacks Movement Speed and both defences.

items.buyWhen: Engage tanks who cast constantly and need to reach the back line.

items.name: Thunder Belt

passive.name: Thunderbolt
passive.text: After a skill, the next basic attack deals damage scaled off the target's max HP and slows them.

items.buyWhen: Tanks and fighters that want threat as well as bulk.

items.name: Magic Shoes
items.buyWhen: The default boot for anyone whose skills are the damage.

items.name: Swift Boots
items.buyWhen: Marksmen and basic-attack fighters.

items.name: Warrior Boots

passive.name: Focusing Mark
passive.text: Taking basic-attack damage stacks extra Physical Defense.

items.buyWhen: Against a physical lane opponent — most exp and gold lanes.

items.name: Tough Boots

passive.name: Tenacity
passive.text: Shortens the duration of crowd control.

items.buyWhen: Against a heavy crowd-control line-up — the tenacity matters more than the defence.

items.name: Arcane Boots
items.buyWhen: Mages, from the first back onward.

items.name: Demon Shoes

passive.name: Mana Spring
passive.text: Restores Mana on kills and assists.

items.buyWhen: Mana-hungry heroes with no other regen in the build.

items.name: Rapid Boots

passive.name: Wind Chant
passive.text: Grants further Movement Speed on top of the base bonus.

items.buyWhen: Roamers and rotators — the map speed is worth more than the stat.
